sloka: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्रस्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नभश्च ।शैलान् समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।। ६.५९.४२ ।।।।
transliteration: tato gavākṣo gavayaḥ sudaṁṣṭrastatharṣabho jyotimukho nabhaśca ।śailān samudyamya vivṛddhakāyāḥ pradudruvustaṁ prati rākṣasendram ।। 6.59.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.
